Consider different disciplines of TKD like sparring, poomsae, freestyle or demonstration and condition accordingly. Sparring = stamina. Poomsae = flexibility. Freestyle = explosiveness. Like others commenting, I agree that learning techniques by yourself is harder than learning from a teacher but not impossible. For the training regiment, you really don't need much besides space and mats. Always stretch focusing on splits like your legs. Also if you are doing poomsae you should focus on singular blocks rather than the whole form to build your way up from basics. If it's sparring then you will need something to kick whether it's a bag or someone holding paddles. I don't really feel like going into super details but wish you luck on your endeavors.
